purpose: Field Navigator recommendation-quality benchmark for six bounded research questions.
source_policy: Fixtures contain only public questions, target branches, and factual paper title/identifier/primary-source metadata. They are anchors for retrieval and ranking checks, not a claim that the listed papers exhaust a field.

cases.research_question: How do orientation, electrostatic control, disorder, dimensionality and interface chemistry govern superconductivity in KTaO3-based two-dimensional electron gases?

target_branches.label: orientation and interface realizations
gate, carrier density, disorder and confinement
two-dimensionality, BKT and phase coherence
experimentally constrained pairing mechanisms
interface chemistry tied to the superconducting 2DEG

Superfluid stiffness of a KTaO3-based two-dimensional electron gas
